eyebrow: Decoupled from the job's own recovery
code:
# Stop new Pods from landing on the bad node
kubectl cordon node-47

# Evict what's already running, so hardware
# diagnostics can proceed safely
kubectl drain node-47 --ignore-daemonsets
caption: The job doesn't wait for this to finish — it re-forms and resumes with the ranks it has while node-47 is investigated separately.
